---
title: "Adnan Ghribi"
subtitle: "Accelerator physicist, GANIL (CNRS), Caen"
---

Research engineer at CNRS, based at GANIL since 2014.
Works on artificial intelligence for particle accelerators and on collective effects in the FCC-ee high energy booster.
Visiting scientist at CERN (BE-ABP-LAF) since 2024.

Earlier work in experimental cosmology: superconducting millimetre-wave components, bolometric interferometry (QUBIC) and the POLARBEAR experiment, at APC Paris and UC Berkeley.
Then cryogenics for the SPIRAL2 superconducting linac at GANIL.
